title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ‘Resilient Communities’ project in Pibor County in South Sudan, implemented by Oxfam through ICSP will directly reach 27,000 returnees, internally displaced persons and host communities. Oxfam will partner in 2026 with Coalition for Humanity and continue partnerships with government and CSOs to ensure that these conflict-affected communities especially women and youth will have improved resilience to protect, adopt and absorb shocks from all forms of disasters through integrated food security, climate resilience, gender, good governance and peace building interventions. The interventions are focused towards empowering the established community structures to deliver on their roles. ICSP Impact 2. delivers on increased awareness and protection of rights of women, youth and children around impact areas, increased participation of community-based groups in gender responsive budget and service delivery monitoring and demand for accountability. It also promotes transformative women leadership.
